name: What if my rental property needs repairs before I can sell it?

mainEntity.name: What if my rental property needs repairs before I can sell it?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your rental property requires repairs, we can help assess which improvements would yield the best return on investment and which might not be necessary. A decision factor is balancing the cost and time of repairs against the potential increase in sale price and market appeal. Kelby Contreras can offer guidance on cost-effective repairs and connect you with local contractors in areas like Miami, Fort Lauderdale, or Palm Beach, ensuring your property is presented optimally to attract buyers without unnecessary expenditure.
acceptedAnswer.description: We help you decide which repairs offer the best return. We can guide on cost-effective improvements and connect you with local contractors.
